decisions.name: CanonicalLedgerOverProviderStatuses
decisions.reason: Dirty backoffice work starts with incompatible provider payloads. Normalizing early keeps replay, reconciliation, and case logic typed and reviewable.
decisions.author: Codex

decisions.name: ReplayEverythingFromCanonicalEvents
decisions.reason: Dirty payment integrations are easiest to audit when the stored history stays immutable. Replaying canonical events keeps dedupe and reconciliation readable instead of hiding rules in writes.
decisions.author: Codex

decisions.name: ManualReviewInsteadOfSilentFixup
decisions.reason: Backoffice systems should not silently fix suspicious payment histories. Opening explicit manual-review cases keeps the risk visible and auditable.
decisions.author: Codex

decisions.name: SettlementIsEvidenceNotTruth
decisions.reason: Settlement files are operationally important, but they are not always clean or complete. Treating them as evidence instead of unquestioned truth leaves room for explicit review cases.
decisions.author: Codex

decisions.name: AppendOnlyEventsAndSettlements
decisions.reason: Webhook and settlement ingestion should preserve raw ordering and dedupe boundaries. Review cases mutate over time, so they stay in a rewriteable current-state file.
decisions.author: Codex
